items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: No, I played a couple of times with him but I wasn't a member of his band.

ctx.x: I wanted to follow up, were you a member of Roy Brown's band? Did you tour with him?
No, I played a couple of times with him but I wasn't a member of his band. You just made the record dates. Yeah, that was just a little bunch of wild kids, you know.
Well that was a question I was going to get to. They called that music that Roy Brown was doing at that time, rhythm and blues music. Yes. Did you take it seriously? Did jazz musicians?
